explanation: OEIS A102847 (a(0) = 1, a(n) = a(n−1)² + 2; primes at n = 1, 2, 4; composite for 5 ≤ n ≤ 19 per R. Cox): 'When is the next prime in the sequence?' The formal statement sets answer = sInf {n > 4 | a(n) prime}, the index of the next prime (0 if none). 'When' asks for the index, so this is a faithful value-question formulation.
